name: nepal_post_1986

This fixture is a synthetic probe, not a real birth, so no hand-cast kundali exists for it or can; what it asserts is Asia/Kathmandu at +5:45:00, and that is what was independently confirmed. Planetary longitudes are not independently confirmed here — they rest on test_invariants.py and the hand-cast graha sphuta table in test_textbook.py. Re-frozen unchanged at engine 0.6.1: the Moon epicycle correction is inside Surya Siddhanta and this fixture is drik, so every value here is byte-identical to 0.6.0 and only the version stamp moved. Engine 0.7.0: the samvatsara now follows Jupiter (surya.barhaspatya_year) instead of a fixed offset from the Shaka year. Nothing else in this chart moved. Engine 0.7.1 adds an empty time_warnings field; no computed value changed.
